**Report to the mayor**

- **PR:** https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561, branch `vcfix-manifest-fallback`.
- **Head:** a new local commit on top of `f3d2ab1fd3b`. I'll add its SHA once the commit runs. Nothing is pushed, so no CI ran and the PR doesn't need re-approval.
- **Test results:** I tested on an API 35 emulator. I built with `flutter build apk --split-per-abi -P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true`, with no `versionCode` in `android {}` or in the manifest.
  - **Clean install:** after `adb uninstall`, `adb install app-arm64-v8a-release.apk` returned `Success`, and `dumpsys package` showed `versionCode=0`.
  - **Install over another build:** I installed a build with `versionCode=7`, then ran `adb install -r` with the same APK. It returned `Failure [INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE]`.
  - So `@mboetger` is right. "Android refuses to install" was wrong. These APKs install on a clean device but can't replace an installed build that has a positive `versionCode`.
- **What changed:** I rewrote that one KDoc sentence to match these results. The flag still doesn't help: the split APKs all share `versionCode` 0, so they can't upgrade an existing install and Play won't accept them. That's why the error message still leaves the flag out. No code changed, nothing was removed, and nothing outside the stated scope changed.
- **Checks:** the commit isn't made yet, so I have no `ktlintCheck`/`test` output to show. Since only a comment changes, I expect both to pass.
